name: Terraform-manage the full AWS estate + a complete, maintainable infra/aws/terraform
description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-08. (1) Assess ALL AWS resources + make sure everything is properly Terraformed; (2) make infra/aws/terraform properly maintained + representing all resource groups. Terraform is the mandated deploy mechanism, but there is no verified guarantee that EVERY live AWS resource is under TF, that TF-state matches live (0 drift), that there are no orphans, and that infra/aws/terraform cleanly represents all resource groups. Un-managed resources are invisible-to-review, drift-prone, deploy/recovery risks. END-STATE: every live resource is TF-managed (in state, 0-diff) OR documented-EXEMPT (bootstrap/state/third-party-by-design); infra/aws/terraform represents all resource groups maintainably; a STANDING coverage gate prevents regression. HIGHEST-RISK project class (live AWS + TF state) -- assess-first read-only, imports+TF-adopts-live primary (0 live change), NEVER destroy/replace a live resource without explicit human sign-off, safe-apply for every apply, firm-separation preserved, ground on LIVE AWS not comp-iam-DESIRED-alone. PRD docs/architecture/NFRA_TERRAFORM_PRD.md.
phase: PHASE 0 -- PRD CTO-authored 2026-07-08 (Andrew-direct), awaiting COO (base) decomposition. 4 PHASES: P1 COVERAGE ASSESSMENT (read-only unblocker; enumerate every live AWS resource + reconcile vs TF state -> per-service/per-resource-group coverage matrix: managed-clean/managed-drifted/unmanaged/orphaned/exempt; ground on LIVE AWS not comp-iam-DESIRED-alone; fan-out-worthy); P2 REMEDIATION (unmanaged->terraform-import@0-diff, drifted->prefer-TF-adopts-live, orphaned->investigate-not-blind-destroy; safe-apply-gated, per-resource-group, incremental; NO destroy/replace without human sign-off); P3 ORGANIZATION (infra/aws/terraform represents all resource groups, maintainable module structure, source-maps complete); P4 STANDING MAINTENANCE (coverage gate extends lambda-source-map CI drift-detection to ALL resource types + on-demand coverage query comp-tf-coverage; must FIRE on a test unmanaged resource, GOV-A I3). Builds on TERRAFORM_PIPELINE_STRATEGY + LAMBDA_TERRAFORM_MAP + EC2_MANIFEST + AWS_INFRASTRUCTURE_MANIFEST + prior audits.
blocking: None to the PRD. COO (base) decomposition + GO (Andrew-direct: base COO owns the infra/deploy lane). Sequence P1 (assess, read-only unblocker) -> P2 (remediate, safe-apply-gated) -> P3 (organize) -> P4 (maintain). CTO arch-gates each phase (coverage method / remediation-safety / org structure / maintenance gate); CVO certs LIVE-grounded assessment + 0-diff-APPLIED==DESIRED remediation (Rule 22a exercised) + gate-FIRES (I3). Executors = AE infra lanes (0.7.0/0.8.0, infra/ owned-paths). 4 open decisions (SS9): exempt criteria / drift-reconciliation default / P4 gate mechanism / P3 reorg aggressiveness.
depends_on_note: Builds on the TF strategy + source-maps + prior audits; makes them comprehensive + standing. USES comp-aws/comp-iam (TF-declared DESIRED side) + comp-iam reconcile (drift) + live AWS (APPLIED side). COMPLEMENTS NFRA_SYSTEM (the TF estate is part of the graph-infra scope class NFRA_SYSTEM documents; NFRA_TERRAFORM makes the infra real-and-managed). Precedes NFRA_LOCALROOT (the local-root structural organization follows the cloud-resource mapping).
